analysis.executiveSummary: Ravens Regime proposes sending Jaylen Waddle and Deebo Samuel Sr. to Mile High Royal Lions for Travis Kelce and a 2029 1st-round pick. From the user's perspective, this transaction is a massive success: it solves the critical TE void (replacing Eli Raridon's 21.9 C-AVI with Travis Kelce's 79.3 C-AVI) while adding premium future 1st-round draft capital. However, for Mile High Royal Lions—who are also explicitly pursuing an Increase Playoff Odds objective—surrendering their starting elite TE1 and a future 1st-round pick for two WRs creates a net downgrade in their immediate weekly starting C-AVI (-15.3 points). As a result, the submitted deal is highly unlikely to be accepted by Mile High as constructed, prompting a recommendation to Revise Offer by removing the 2029 1st-round pick.
